rootCause.hypothesis: fix-2 made the cut rules (a) ?#; and (b) =& shape-independent, but the userinfo strip (c) and the path rule still recognise a URL shape: stripUserinfo strips only the authority of the FIRST scheme:// in a token, and reducePathToken returns the WHOLE token unchanged when schemeEnd(t) >= 0. Anything glued after the first URL in a whitespace-free token (JSON, fetch args, comma lists, JSON.stringify output in errors) keeps a second URL user:password@ and full local paths.
rootCause.wrong: implementation (and the tests share the blind spot: no generated cell has two URLs, or a URL plus a path, in one whitespace-free token); the spec (R1: D5 on every URL-bearing string) and the documented rule are right
rootCause.fixDirection: apply (c) to every authority in a token; end the scheme:// exemption at the first character that cannot belong to the URL (quote, comma, bracket, pipe, paren, second scheme) and reduce the rest by the path rule; add multi-URL-per-token and U+202A..U+202E cells
